title: Information Regarding Armed Robbery In K. Mondenachs Jewellery Store, 1163 Bubbling Well Road On 20-7

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 8052
2nd July 37
Date JULLY 27, 1937

Subject Information regarding armed robbery in K.Mondenach's Jewellery
Store,1163 Bubbling Well Road on 20-7-37.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.S.

On the morning of July 26,1937 I received a letter
from a Russian named P.Patrikeyeff,who is employed with the
Shanghai Waterworks Co.,Ltd and at present is confined to the
Russian Orthodox Confraternity's Hospital,230 Route de Say Zoong,
stating that he had some information regarding the armed robbery
which occurred in K. Mondenach's Jewellery Store,1163 Bubbling
Well Road, on 20-7-37.

Interviewed at 11.30 a.m. on the same date at the
said hospital,Patrikeyeff stated that he suspected the following
three persons of being concerned in the above crime: M.J. Birden,
Miss E.I. Tretiakova and L. Dombrovaky.

Morris Iosifovitch BIRDEN claims to be a Belgian
subject. He speaks Russian and has a typical Jewish appearance.
He was recently a patient of the Second Class section of the
Russian Orthodox Confraternity's Hospital and paid $ 5.00 per
day for his room. He was often visited by Miss Tretiakova, who
was a patient of the Third Class section of the same hospital.
These two people were frequently visited by one Leonid Dombrovsky,
a paramour of Miss Tretiakova and a well known criminal (burglar),
whom Patrikeyeff knew in Harbin. He was strongly suspected of
having participated in the kidnapping of Litz,Garle and Blankman,
owners of an omnibus company and municipal contractors in Harbin.
Dombrovsky was then employed as a chauffeur with the said omnibus
company. The kidnapped persons are alleged to have paid ransom
of $ 50,000.

Shortly after the robbery in Mondenach's store had
taken place, Patrikeyeff overheard a conversation between Birden
and Dombrovsky in the hospital during the course of which one of
them asked" Where shall we hide the goods?". Putting his observa-

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科（Special Branch）第一股
报告
档案号 8052
37年7月2日
日期：1937年7月27日

主题：关于1937年7月20日发生在静安寺路1163号 K. Mondenach 珠宝店的持械抢劫案的情报。
呈报人：警佐 Tcheremshansky 转呈人：C. Crawford. 警佐

1937年7月26日上午，我收到一封来自名为 P. Patrikeyeff 的俄国人的来信，此人受雇于上海自来水公司（Shanghai Waterworks Co., Ltd），目前正住在西爱咸斯路230号俄国东正教兄弟会医院。信中表示，他掌握有关1937年7月20日发生在静安寺路1163号 K. Mondenach 珠宝店持械抢劫案的一些情报。

同日中午11时30分，我在上述医院对 Patrikeyeff 进行了问话。Patrikeyeff 称，他怀疑以下三人参与了上述犯罪：M.J. Birden、E.I. Tretiakova 小姐和 L. Dombrovaky。

Morris Iosifovitch BIRDEN 自称是比利时籍臣民。他会讲俄语，具有典型的犹太人外貌。他最近是俄国东正教兄弟会医院二等病房的病人，每天支付5.00元房费。Tretiakova 小姐经常探望他，她是同一所医院三等病房的病人。这两人经常受到一名 Leonid Dombrovsky 的探访，此人是 Tretiakova 小姐的情夫，也是一名众所周知的罪犯（窃贼），Patrikeyeff 在哈尔滨时就认识他。他有重大嫌疑参与了绑架哈尔滨一家公共汽车公司及市政承包商的所有者 Litz、Garle 和 Blankman 的案件。Dombrovsky 当时受雇于该公共汽车公司担任司机。据称被绑架者支付了50,000元的赎金。

在 Mondenach 商店抢劫案发生后不久，Patrikeyeff 在医院无意中听到了 Birden 和 Dombrovsky 之间的谈话，期间其中一人问道：“我们把赃物藏在哪里？”结合他的观察……

the crime in question, Patrikeyeff decided to report his suspicions
to the Police.
        According to the hospital register Birden was a
patient of Dr. E. Joffe who recently left for Belgium. He was suf-
fering from an ulcerated stomach and was only treated through a
a diet. He remained in the hospital from June 29 to July 24 and
during this period is known to have gone out of the hospital on
several occasions. He gave his address as 83 Carter Road. From
enquiries made it appears that no person bearing the name Birden
is known at this address.
        Miss Elisaveta Ivanovna Tretiakova, 24, Russian, was
a patient of Dr. Antonova and was operated on while in hospital.
She stayed in the hospital from June 2 to July 24 . Approximately
two days before she left the hospital she applied for permission
to go out on some pretext. She appeared to be rather excited on
that occasion. She gave her address as 226 Route Vallon.
        Miss Tretiakova is of a medium height, slim build and has brown
hair and typically Russian appearance.
        The above information was immediately passed by the
undersigned to D.S.I. Bebenin ( C.I ) and D.S.I. Goloobkoff ( Bub-
bling Well).

……以及他从报纸上了解到的有关该罪行的情况，Patrikeyeff 决定向警方报告他的怀疑。
        根据医院登记簿，Birden 是 E. Joffe 医生的病人，该医生最近已前往比利时。他患有胃溃疡，仅通过饮食疗法进行治疗。他从6月29日至7月24日住院，在此期间已知曾多次外出。他提供的地址是卡特路83号。经查询，该地址无人知晓名为 Birden 的人。
        Elisaveta Ivanovna Tretiakova 小姐，24岁，俄国人，是 Antonova 医生的病人，住院期间接受了手术。她从6月2日至7月24日住院。在出院前大约两天，她以某种借口申请外出许可。当时她显得相当激动。她提供的地址是法伦路226号。
        Tretiakova 小姐身材中等，体型苗条，棕色头发，具有典型的俄国人外貌。
        上述情报已由下述签署人立即转交给特务科督察 Bebenin ( C.I ) 和静安寺路分局督察 Goloobkoff。
